title: Konrad Zuse's calculating space and nuclear detonation test

tellings.quote: He theorized that it would be possible to test this in extremely high entropy events such as for example the detonation of a nuclear bomb.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a researcher, describes the idea of Konrad Zuse, a German thinker who wrote a work called Rechnender Raum, or "calculating space," proposing that the universe itself works like a computation. According to Jorjani, Zuse theorized this could be tested during extremely chaotic, high-energy events such as a nuclear bomb blast, an idea Jorjani took up in a piece on his Substack, an online newsletter, titled Nuking the Matrix. If right, it would mean reality could be shown to run like a computer.
